top_story.headline: Two Sitting House Members Still Have No 2025 Annual Financial Disclosure on File
top_story.dek: Rep. Michael T. McCaul and Rep. Dan Crenshaw are both 53 days past their final extension date.
paragraphs: A cross-check of the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD finds that Rep. Michael T. McCaul (R-TX-10) filed an extension on 4/29/2026, and Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed one on 6/4/2026. Neither has an annual report for calendar year 2025 on file, and the final extension date for both, 8/13/2026, passed 53 days ago.

The automated check matches on names, so a filing under an unexpected spelling could read as missing. Separately, Michelle White Bowman and six other confirmed officials have no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance, more than 30 days past deadline; those findings are in the Deadline Watch and Ethics Agreement Tracker sections below.

sections.headline: No Material Divestiture or Termination Filings in the Ethics Window
paragraphs: Ethics filings from the past three days contained no divestitures, terminations, or other noteworthy disclosures requiring immediate attention.

sections.headline: No New House or Senate Filings Since the Last Edition
paragraphs: Every House filing dated 10/2/2026 or later was checked in the Clerk of the House bulk index: the most recent entries are dated 10/1/2026 and were already reported in earlier editions. The Senate eFD search for filings submitted since 10/2/2026 returned zero rows. No trade tables are included because there were no new Periodic Transaction Reports to read.

sections.headline: No New Lobbying Registrations; 99 Filings Are Mostly Third-Quarter Reports
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying disclosure API shows zero new registrations posted since 10/4/2026. It lists 99 other filings in the window: 70 third-quarter reports, 22 third-quarter reports marked as year-to-date (Q3Y), and 7 termination or amendment filings, shown below. The 92 routine third-quarter reports were not read individually; issue areas were not read for this edition, and none was matched to a bill or member in today's other editions.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
